0.original: Sthalrhet hopes to send you out on a hunt.

1.original: Sthalrhet asks you to eradicate sea wasps so that his brother will not have the opportunity to delight in them.

2.original: Deliver the sea wasps you have culled to Sthalrhet.

3.original: Sthalrhet savors his brother's misfortune, and is happy to give the sea wasps to anyone who is not Nortmoen.

24.original: Slay sea wasps and obtain their rotting umbrellas.

25.original: Deliver the rotting umbrellas to Sthalrhet.

48.original: You seem an adventurer in need of work, and here I am a man in need of dead sea wasps. Perhaps we might help each other.

49.original: Mind you, I've no interest in chewing on the viscous vermin myself, but my brother can't seem to get enough of them, the uncouth cad.

50.original: I'll not stand to watch him stuff his gob full of those prickly pests one more day! Ah, what I wouldn't give to see the look on his face when I tell him you've hunted down all his precious sea wasps! But don't expect me to reward you without proof─I'll need to see their rotting carcasses first.

53.original: I trust you're busy delivering those sea wasp souls to the deep? Just make sure you don't give their corpses to my brother!

54.original: Now this is what I deem a proper slaughter! Excellent.

55.original: All that remains is to determine how to dispose of the wretched things. I suppose there must be somebody in my brigade that can stomach them...
